review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: The jth sweet of type i is a unit job released at floor((j-1)S/a_i)+1 and due at ceil(jS/a_i), obtained from both strict balance inequalities. Earliest-deadline-first among released jobs maximizes the feasible prefix. Multiple jobs due today make the current purchase impossible without breaking balance. Reaching the next multiple of S fixes every count exactly and returns to the same periodic quota state, from which a balanced unit-job schedule repeats forever.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
